title: Berin on the Gullhaven quay says he owes the harbourmaster 6 gold and 'can't go home... not owing that,' clearly inviting help, but no dialogue option to pay it off ever appeared even after I had 30 gold.
where: The Quay, Gullhaven, talk to Berin
